Enabling TF32 allows the hardware to use Tensor Core MMA instructions. K=768 is moderate: TF32 accumulated error ~4e-6, well within atol=1e-3. L2 hit rate of 97.22% confirms data is cache-resident, so the bottleneck is purely compute throughput.
